statement: To warm transfer a signed client to Fears-Dudley, follow these steps: 1. After the client signs the representation agreement and you've sent the Welcome Kit, ask the client if you can transfer them to the firm. 2. If they agree, select transfer. 3. Choose Fears Dudley Warm Transfer. 4. Select "speak and transfer". 5. Get the Fears Dudley agent on the phone. 6. Introduce the client to the Fears representative. 7. Confirm the handoff is complete and both parties are connected. 8. Pause recording. 9. Drop off the call. 10. Monitor the call briefly to ensure the transfer was successful. 11. If the transfer fails, call the client back immediately and attempt to reconnect them or alternative contact. 12. If you reach voicemail, leave a message with the client's name, accident details, and callback number. 13. After a successful transfer, return to the deal note and record the name of the Fears representative who received the call. 14. Finalize all intake documentation and move the deal to "Distribute".
